title: Activation Probe Transferability Across Fine-Tuned Variants of the Same Base Model

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If probes degrade under benign fine-tuning, monitoring systems need retraining per model update -- a major operational finding for AI providers. Clear, actionable implication.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: LoRA fine-tuning is well-documented and feasible on single GPU. Activation extraction and probe training are standard. Beginners need to manage multiple model variants and checkpoints, which adds complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single base model, one probe type, degradation measured as function of fine-tuning steps. Clean independent variable. Deliverable is a clear curve. Fits 30 hours well.
